channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: New front in US-Iran war escalates as Houthis fire at Saudi oil facilities
item.description: Conflict also spreads to Caspian Sea as Tehran accuses Ukraine of a deadly attack on an Iranian vessel.

item.title: US military disables tanker accused of breaking the Iran blockade
item.description: The US military has released footage it says shows forces boarding one tanker.

item.title: Tehran summons Ukrainian diplomat after Kyiv bombs an Iranian ship
item.description: Iran has condemned a Ukrainian attack on one of its commercial vessels.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis target Saudi oil facilities along the Red Sea
item.description: Yemen's Houthis say they have targeted oil facilities in Saudi Arabia owned by Aramco.

item.title: Iran war live: Baghaei says progress made in Oman talks on Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Tehran says the Ukrainian attack killed at least one sailor and wounded another.

item.title: Iran accuses Ukraine of deadly attack on Caspian commercial vessel
item.description: Iran accuses Ukraine of attacking a Caspian vessel, killing one sailor and injuring another, calling it a criminal act.

item.title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
item.description: US military says it disabled a tanker that was attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports.

item.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
item.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

item.title: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
item.description: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.
